other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Application context is a ceramic-sector company manufacturing H-10 masonry blocks, with kiln/oven baking (preheating, burning, cooling)
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
Application of the procedure of the ISO 50001:2011 standard for 
energy planning in a company ceramic sector

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Description of ceramic-industry processing phases (paste preparation, molding, baking/sintering)
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
Within the ceramic industry case, the processing of the 
raw material consists mainly of three phases, which are; 
preparation of the ceramic paste, molding of the piece and 
baking.

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Kiln/oven firing stages in ceramic block production
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
One of the final stages of this process is 
the baking done in the ovens. For its execution, the oven goes 
through three stages: preheating, burning and cooling

one_line: The paper applies ISO 50001 energy planning and statistical monitoring to electric-energy consumption in a ceramic company manufacturing H-10 masonry blocks (discrete ceramic/brick production with kiln firing), which is not among the eight registered Corpus B sectors.
